arxiv-1806-10186.title: A Zynq-–based flexible ADC architecture combining real-time data streaming and transient recording
arxiv-1806-10186.creator: A. Rigoni, G. Manduchi, M. Gottado, R. Cavazzana, M. Recchia, C. Taliercio, A. Luchetta
arxiv-1806-10186.description: Abstract The RFX-mod2 Nuclear Fusion experiment is an upgrade of RFX-mod, shutdown in 2016. Among the other improvements in the machine structure and diagnostics, a larger number of electromagnetic probes (EMs) is foreseen to provide more information about plasma instabilities and to allow an improved real-time plasma control.

arxiv-2003-02422.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Robust Protection in DER-Rich Distribution Grids
arxiv-2003-02422.creator: Dongqi Wu, Dileep Kalathil, Miroslav Begovic, and Le Xie
arxiv-2003-02422.description: Abstract This paper introduces the concept of Deep Reinforcement Learning based architecture for protective relay design in power distribution systems with many distributed energy resources (DERs). The performance of widely-used overcurrent protection scheme is hindered by the presence of distributed generation, power electronic interfaced devices and fault impedance.

arxiv-2206-12709.title: A Random Adaptation Perspective on Distributed Averaging
arxiv-2206-12709.creator: Rohit Parasnis, Ashwin Verma, Massimo Franceschetti, Behrouz Touri
arxiv-2206-12709.description: Abstract We propose a random adaptation variant of time-varying distributed averaging dynamics in discrete time. We show that this leads to novel interpretations of fundamental concepts in distributed averaging, opinion dynamics, and distributed learning. arxiv-2210-14140.description: Abstract Generating text with autoregressive language models (LMs) is of great importance to many natural language processing (NLP) applications. arxiv-2310-01518.title: Measurement of t t -channel single-top-quark production in p ​ p pp collisions at s = 5.02 \sqrt{s}=5.02 TeV with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-2310-01518.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-2310-01518.description: Abstract The observation of the electroweak production of single-top-quarks is made using 255 pb − 1 \text{pb}^{-1} of proton-proton collision data recorded at s = 5.02 \sqrt{s}=5.02 TeV with the ATLAS detector at the Large Hadron Collider. An event selection is used to identify single-top-quark candidates arising from t t -channel production with the top quark decaying semi-leptonically.

arxiv-2406-06580.title: Break the Chain: Large Language Models Can be Shortcut Reasoners
arxiv-2406-06580.creator: Mengru Ding Gaode Map, Alibaba Group dingmengru.dmr@alibaba-inc.com, Hanmeng Liu Zhejiang University liuhanmeng@zju.edu.cn Zhizhang FuGaode Map, Alibaba Group fuzhizhang.fzz@alibaba-inc.com Jian SongWenbo XieGaode Map, Alibaba Group james.songjian, daoqian.xwb@alibaba-inc.com Yue Zhang †Westlake Uni
arxiv-2406-06580.description: Abstract Recent advancements in Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning utilize complex modules but are hampered by high token consumption, limited applicability, and challenges in reproducibility. This paper conducts a critical evaluation of CoT prompting, extending beyond arithmetic to include complex logical and commonsense reasoning tasks, areas where standard CoT methods fall short.

arxiv-2407-06501.title: StorySumm : Evaluating Faithfulness in Story Summarization
arxiv-2407-06501.creator: Melanie Subbiah *, Faisal Ladhak *, Akankshya Mishra, Griffin Adams, Lydia B. Chilton, Kathleen McKeown
arxiv-2407-06501.description: Abstract Human evaluation has been the gold standard for checking faithfulness in abstractive summarization. However, with a challenging source domain like narrative, multiple annotators can agree a summary is faithful, while missing details that are obvious errors only once pointed out.

arxiv-2411-10103.title: SUPPRESSION OF DIFFRACTION IN DIS ON NUCLEI AND DYNAMICAL MECHANISM OF LEADING TWIST NUCLEAR SHADOWING Thanks: Presented at Diffraction and Low- x x 2024, Palermo, Italy, September 8-14, 2024
arxiv-2411-10103.creator: V. Guzey
arxiv-2411-10103.description: Abstract Using the leading twist approach (LTA) to nuclear shadowing (NS), we calculate the ratio of the diffractive-to-total DIS cross sections R diff / tot R_{\rm diff/tot} for a heavy nucleus and proton and confirm that R diff / tot ≈ 0.5 − 1 R_{\rm diff/tot}\approx 0.5-1 in contrast with R diff / tot ≈ 1.

arxiv-2501-12565.title: The Maximum Number of Sets for 12 12 Cards is 14 14
arxiv-2501-12565.creator: Justin Stevens, Duncan Wilson
arxiv-2501-12565.description: Abstract We present a novel proof that the maximum number of sets with 4 4 properties for 12 12 cards is 14 14 using the geometry of the finite field 𝔽 3 4 \mathbb{F}_{3}^{4} , number theory, combinatorics, and graph theory. We also present several computer algorithms for finding the maximum number of sets.

arxiv-2506-19127.title: Entropy from scattering in weakly interacting systems
arxiv-2506-19127.creator: Duncan MacIntyre and Gordon W. Semenoff Department of Physics and Astronomy, University of British Columbia, 6224 Agricultural Road, Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada V6T 1Z1
arxiv-2506-19127.description: Abstract Perturbation theory is used to investigate the evolution of the von Neumann entropy of a subsystem of a bipartite quantum system in the course of a gedanken scattering experiment. We find surprisingly simple criteria for the initial state and the scattering matrix that guarantee that the subsystem entropy increases.

arxiv-2507-08003.title: A Versatile Dataset of Mouse and Eye Movements on Search Engine Results Pages Conference: Proceedings of the 48th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval; July 13–18, 2025; Padua, Italy Proceedings of the 48th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Rese
arxiv-2507-08003.creator: Kayhan Latifzadeh, Jacek Gwizdka, Luis A. Leiva
arxiv-2507-08003.description: Abstract . We contribute a comprehensive dataset to study user attention and purchasing behavior on Search Engine Result Pages (SERPs). Previous work has relied on mouse movements as a low-cost large-scale behavioral proxy but also has relied on self-reported ground-truth labels, collected at post-task, which can be inaccurate and prone to biases.

arxiv-2508-16388.title: Arrow-chasing in Pascal’s triangle – Visual proofs for summation formulas involving binomial coefficients
arxiv-2508-16388.creator: Regula Krapf
arxiv-2508-16388.description: Abstract This article demonstrates, using numerous examples of varying complexity, how one can visually prove summation formulas involving binomial coefficients by exclusively using the recurrence relation for binomial coefficients and its illustration through arrows in Pascal’s triangle. The method developed for this purpose, which we call ‘arrow-chasing’, is elementary and it is accessible to a very broad audience.

pmc-10727133.creator: Walid Abukhudair, Ahmad Z. Hafiz, Mohammed A. Alosaimi, Fares A. Alaynayn, Fahad A. Alosaimi, Rehab A. Karam, Tamer M. Abdelrahman
pmc-10727133.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). IntroductionsThe awareness of brain death and heart donation (HD) among the Saudi population remains limited, coupled with negative attitudes toward heart donation, resulting in a significant gap between the demand for donor hearts and the available supply. This study aimed to comprehensively understand the current perceptions, attitudes, and practices of the Saudi population regarding HD, as well as identify the obstacles.

pmc-12837863.title: Cytotoxicity of Cannabinoids in Combination with Traditional Lymphoma Chemotherapeutic Drugs Against Non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma
pmc-12837863.creator: Saba Omer, Mahmoud Mansour, Satyanarayana R Pondugula, Muralikrishnan Dhanasekaran, Brad Matz, Omer Khan, Dawn Boothe
pmc-12837863.description: Background: Cannabinoids (CBs) are FDA-approved for mitigating chemotherapy-induced side effects such as pain, nausea, and loss of appetite. Beyond palliative care, CBs exhibit anti-tumor properties in various cancers, including non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma (NHL). Previously, we demonstrated the cytotoxic effect of endogenous and exogenous cannabinoids on human and canine B- and T-cell-type NHL cell lines.

pmc-13281205.title: Bi-temporal processing in music notation reading: a theory linking prediction, memory, and automaticity
pmc-13281205.creator: Karen L. Heath
pmc-13281205.description: Reading music notation requires musicians to extract and interpret visual information in real time while simultaneously anticipating future performance actions. This dual engagement, in which one acts in the present while processing material to be performed in the future, suggests that music reading relies on a bi-temporal cognitive architecture.

pmc-13380436.description: SummaryA purple chromatic anomaly emerged on the earthen surfaces of UNESCO Terracotta Warriors Pit No. 1. pmc-13607261.title: Diagnostic Discrepancies Between Emergency Department Assessment and Internal Medicine Discharge Diagnosis: A Prospective Observational Study in a Swiss Tertiary Hospital
pmc-13607261.creator: Theresa Ackfeld, Youcef Guechi, Joseph Schwab, Thomas Castelain, Ludovic Galofaro, Cynthia Gay, Sébastien Pugnale, Thomas Schmutz, Wolf E. Hautz, Vincent Ribordy
pmc-13607261.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objective: Diagnostic safety is a major challenge in emergency departments (ED), where clinicians frequently make decisions under time pressure and with incomplete information. Prospective data on diagnostic discrepancies in Swiss EDs remain limited. To determine the frequency of diagnostic discrepancies between the initial ED diagnosis and the final Internal Medicine (IM) discharge diagnosis, identify associated patient-, physician-, and context-related factors, and evaluate clinical outcomes associated with diagnostic discrepancy.
